```{r}
N <- 250
S <- 51
```

# AR(1)

```{r}
e <- rnorm(N)
y <- numeric(N) # rep(0, N)
x <- numeric(N)
```

```{r}
for (t in 2:N) y[t] <- .8 * y[t - 1] + e[t]
y <- y[S:N]

arima(y, order = c(1, 0, 0), include.mean = FALSE)
```

```{r}
for (t in 2:N) x[t] <- 10 + .8 * x[t - 1] + e[t]
x <- x[S:N]

arima(x, order = c(1, 0, 0))
```

# SARIMA(1,1,0)(1,0,0)[4]

```{r}
# 1 - 1.5 L + 0.5 L^2 - 0.0016 L^4 + 0.0024 L^5 - 0.0008 L^6
e <- rnorm(5*N)
z <- numeric(5*N)
for (t in 7:(5*N)) z[t] <- 1.5 * z[t - 1] - 0.5 * z[t - 2] + 0.0016 * z[t - 4] - 0.0024 * z[t - 5] + 0.0008 * z[t - 6] + e[t]
z <- ts(z[-(1:50)], frequency = 4)
```

```{r}
plot(z)
```

```{r}
forecast::auto.arima(z)
```
